item.text:
Performed another refactor focused on type safety in the core grid model.

`Field` now stores `Actor[][]` instead of `Object[][]`, and its `place(...)` / `getObjectAt(...)` API is typed accordingly in [Field.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/Field.java:20) and [Field.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/Field.java:64). That let me simplify several callers: mate lookup and prey lookup in [Animal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/Animal.java:165) and [Animal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/Animal.java:247), plant occupancy handling in [Grass.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/Grass.java:58), predator movement fallback in [Predator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/Predator.java:36), hunter target lookup in [Hunter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/Hunter.java:76), population counting in [FieldStats.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/FieldStats.java:66), and rendering in [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/SimulatorView.java:182).

This removes a chunk of repeated `Object` casting and an unnecessary `instanceof Actor` check while preserving behavior. Verification: `javac *.java` succeeds.
